scope: Five predstav-family residues outside EDIT-0016's token-start rule in base-papers1-43-isv.tex.
choice: Normalize two medžupredstavjenja compounds to medžuprědstavjenja; correct prědstavljam to prědstavjam, prědstavlja to prědstavja, and the number-defective prědstavjajų to prědstavjajut.
motivation: EDIT-0016 correctly covered every token beginning predstav but could not see compounds whose token began medžu, and it intentionally did not touch already-accented malformed derivatives. Independent bounded QA found these five residues. Official prědstavjati morphology requires the contracted prědstavja/prědstavjam and plural prědstavjajut forms.
alternatives_rejected: Declare zero residue from a word-start regex.
